title: Critique: the universe is unlike a DID subject

statements.text: There are many disanalogies between the universe and a person with DID, and it is unclear how to find analogous within-subject fragmentation at the level of cognitive processes in the universe.

sources.quote: There are many disanalogies between the universe and a DID subject, and it is not at all clear how to find analogous within-subject fragmentation at the level of cognitive processes in the universe.
